_comment: The named allowlist D-35 requires: every NEXT_PUBLIC_* identifier this app is deliberately allowed to expose to the browser. Adding an entry here is a deliberate act with a reviewer — anything listed is readable by every visitor. A Turnstile SITE key is public by design and is not a credential; the SECRET stays a wrangler secret and never appears in any NEXT_PUBLIC_ name.
_forbidden_substrings_comment: Credential names from docs/build/GSD-LAUNCH.md § Secrets and its Cloudflare CI entries. None of these may ever appear in the built client bundle (.open-next/assets/**) — every one reaches the Worker via `wrangler secret put`, never a client-exposed variable.
